metadata.title: SOAR Action Boundary SSPP
metadata.remarks: This SSPP defines absolute boundaries on security automation actions. It specifies actions, systems, and data that SOAR automation must never affect, regardless of playbook approval or detection confidence.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits authority, workflow, response, and forensic constraints and enforces non-negotiable automation boundaries.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines immutable constraints that prevent unsafe, irreversible, or governance-bypassing automation actions.

system-implementation.remarks: Action boundaries defined in this SSPP are absolute. No playbook, authority, or emergency condition may override these constraints.

forbidden-action-categories.description: Actions that declare maliciousness, incidents, severity, or risk acceptance.
Actions that acquire, alter, delete, or analyze forensic evidence.
Actions that change system architecture, control posture, or logging/telemetry configuration.
Actions that bypass escalation, suppress reporting, or close violations.

forbidden-systems.description: Systems designated for forensic acquisition, evidence storage, or investigation.
Root identity stores, trust anchors, and governance identity platforms.
Security monitoring and detection platforms themselves.

automation-hard-stops.statement: SOAR SHALL halt execution when a forensic hold is active or evidence integrity is at risk.
SOAR SHALL NOT suppress escalation paths or downgrade severity.
SOAR SHALL NOT deploy configuration changes that alter baseline security architecture.

control-implementation.description: Controls ensure automation boundaries are enforced and violations are escalated.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Automation capabilities are restricted to approved and least-privileged actions.
Separation of duties prevents automation from assuming decision authority.
Automation supports response only within defined, bounded actions.

statements.statement: SOAR SHALL NOT perform actions that are irreversible or governance-impacting.
Playbook approval SHALL NOT override action boundaries defined in this SSPP.
Boundary violations SHALL be treated as control violations under the Violation & Drift Escalation SSPP.
Emergency response conditions SHALL NOT suspend automation boundaries.

back-matter.remarks: All SOAR execution engines MUST enforce these boundaries at runtime. Lack of enforcement constitutes a critical architecture defect.
